@guyharris Hope the holiday season is good.  Do you know who we might get involved to get this patch underway?

Hi,
Rebase is needed "Fast-forward merge is not possible. To merge this request, first rebase locally."
Does this have any relation with https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1690 ?

They're not incompatible ideas.

To my understanding, the good Dr.'s point is you can use heuristics to determine if a CAN frame is OBD2 or not and not force the OBD2 dissector on frames that are not.

My patch says multi-packet OBD2 messages can be reassembled if we make it a subdissector of the mature ISO-TP dissector instead of partially rewriting ISO-TP support in the OBD2 dissector.

What's good about the Dr.'s work is it can be seen as the start of a broader effort to add much-needed heuristics to CAN.  A mature heuristics effort could lead to wireshark automatically recognizing CAN traffic instead of users being required to manually enable CAN dissectors.

If the Wireshark team is amenable to my patch I can spend some time resolving the merge.
